blurb: Step back in time as you stroll through Charleston's enchanting hidden pathways! This captivating tour takes you to iconic landmarks like Rainbow Row and the Charleston Harbor while unveiling the charm of the French Quarter and South of Broad neighborhoods. Along the way, you'll dive into riveting stories of the American Revolution, Civil War, African heritage, stunning architecture, and so much more. Discover the layers of history that make Charleston on of the most fascinating cities in the world.
